brief: The canvas displays a simulated retro camera viewfinder, characterized by a dark, bordered frame reminiscent of older mobile technology. Inside this frame, a dynamic visual field is presented by horizontal scanlines. These scanlines are in constant motion, appearing to rapidly shift across the viewing area. The most notable visual element is the unpredictable jittering: the continuous wave pattern of the scanlines frequently breaks or skips with sudden, erratic pauses, giving the illusion of transmission instability.

statement: This sketch creates a retro camera viewfinder simulation with dynamic scanlines that move continuously across the screen. The visual effect mimics old mobile phone displays by rendering horizontal lines that shift position with subtle jitter and occasional abrupt pauses or skips. These interruptions create an unstable transmission illusion, while the dark bordered frame reinforces the nostalgic aesthetic of vintage electronics. The animation runs autonomously without user input, satisfying the motion requirement through consistent canvas changes over time.
